refinement.detail: Searched and found none, and the one real candidate was REFUSED for a recorded reason. THE CANDIDATE: stranded_loaders.py's `ast` sweep overlaps score_tools.py's `scope`, which already walks this repository's record looking for claims it can re-derive, and the obvious refinement is to make the stranded-loader census a `scope` sub-mode rather than a separate 198-line file. REFUSED on three grounds, all recorded rather than argued. (1) SCOPE IS THE WRONG POPULATION: CA-08-DF-01 measured `scope` returning ZERO counted figures on charters, plans, baselines and price tables, because it recognises one sentence form over PROSE; the stranded-loader question is about PYTHON IMPORT AND LOAD SITES, which `scope` has no reader for, so this would be a new engine sharing only a directory walk. (2) score_tools.py IS THIS TICKET'S FORBIDDEN SURFACE -- the assignment says defects there are DEFERRED, NOT FIXED and the conflict keys exclude it, so folding a new mode into it is exactly the scope expansion the epic owner ruled against twice. (3) THE MEASUREMENT ARGUES AGAINST IT ANYWAY: SS-07-DF-08 measured that this instrument FAILS 2 of the 3 absent-input states SS-02 now requires, including reporting a clean census over a file it could not parse -- merging a defective reader into the shipped card tool would put that defect inside the instrument RM-02 called the substrate's best export. The honest disposition is the one taken: leave it unregistered, unbound, unrepaired, and filed against itself as SS-07-DF-04 (nothing executes it) and SS-07-DF-08 (it would fail the epic's own new doctrine). No TLC run supports any of this and none is claimed: this ticket adds no TLA+ surface, ticket-local desired and current are byte-identical, and the model delta is zero.

summary: Four standing results verified at 48f9c7e and re-checked at every reconciled tree through 8c3d258. THREE HALVES WERE GENUINELY RE-EXECUTED -- test_journal_conformance.py (14 passed, 70/70 across three wirings), check_catalogue.py --arms (arm C +3.8% longer, 0 of 109 architectural terms, against W=arm C at D3 1/1), and architecture_tags.py derive (16 of 21; NUMERATOR fell 17->16, DENOMINATOR held at 21). THE REST, INCLUDING RESULT 3 ENTIRELY, IS index/history RE-RENDERING SEALED CARDS: proof they open and still say what the record claims, not a recomputation, and no judge was re-run. Result 3 has no re-execution available; result 4 is the one with a real re-run. STRANDED DISPROOF INSTRUMENT DECIDED: DISCLOSE, written where a reader of the claim meets it, editing nothing in that directory. CA-02-DF-04's restore command had never been run; run in a throwaway checkout it reproduces BYTE-IDENTICAL to the sealed transcript -- a PURE REPLAY over inputs frozen at 37ab155 that AUTHENTICATES the transcript and does NOT re-derive the claim against today's record, so CA-08's decision stands. Both withdrawn overstatements struck by name. EIGHT FINDINGS, NOTHING REPAIRED, THREE AGAINST THIS TICKET'S OWN WORK: index mutates 16 of 18 sealed card trees when used to verify them; two sealed-record classifiers overwrite their own evidence; SV-03's no-card demonstration is a SECOND stranded instrument, stranded by success; the check CA-02-DF-04 asked for now exists and nothing runs it; my own published cell exit-code claim was FALSE because I measured it through a pipe (fifth such figure in this epic); my own --selftest was partly vacuous and the vacuity hid a crash on any --root outside the repo; disposition.py --ticket is blind to reviewer-credited rows; and stranded_loaders.py WOULD FAIL SS-02's absent-input check on 2 of 3 states, one being the exact set[str] vs set[str] | None shape the charter uses to define the class. Independent review returned CHANGES with eleven findings and all eleven held. Suite PRE-CLOSE at ab9a244: 7/1554/0/1/1562, they sum. THIS SEALED FIGURE CANNOT DESCRIBE THE TREE THIS CLOSE PRODUCES -- close seals the entry and deletes the workspace in one operation, so the post-close figure is in the live RESULT.md and is the authoritative one for a reader standing in the merged tree.

assertions: Each of the four results is verified INDIVIDUALLY and BY EXECUTION where execution is possible; a sealed transcript alone is not a verification, AND A RENDERER OVER SEALED JSON IS NOT AN EXECUTION EITHER -- say which of the four were re-run and which were re-rendered.

VERIFYING THE RECORD MUST NOT MUTATE IT: score_tools.py index rewrites INDEX.md unconditionally with no read-only mode (SS-07-DF-01), and 16 of 18 sealed trees mutate under it. This goal HARNESS ITSELF instructs every ticket to check that the sealed cards open and render, so the trap is set by the goal. The sealed cards open and render, and the do-not-cut instruments still run.
The stranded disproof instrument is DECIDED as disclose or do-not-cut, and the disclosure is written where a reader of the claim will meet it.

ticket.objective: THE ONLY GOAL THIS PROGRAMME HAS EVER RUN THAT CAUGHT AN EPIC GUARDING SOMETHING ALREADY FALSE. KEEP THE METHOD; DO NOT RE-LITIGATE THE RESULTS. FIRST, RE-VERIFY EACH OF THE FOUR BY EXECUTION WHERE EXECUTION IS POSSIBLE. The precedent is exact: CA-06 re-ran SV-04's result and got '14 passed', matching the sealed figure. A sealed transcript is not a re-verification. Check that the sealed cards OPEN AND RENDER and that scope, seal, contested, the blinding mechanism and the version/served double seal STILL RUN. SECOND, AND THIS IS THE REAL WORK: TWO OF THE FOUR DISPROOFS DID NOT STAND, AND BOTH OVERSTATEMENTS CAME FROM A CHARTER. 'The pricing instrument could only ever return zero' and 'zero unique kills' were both refuted on review. THE DEFENSIBLE SENTENCE IS NEXT-EPIC section 5's: 'a non-zero was the informative outcome, the instrument would have printed one, and none appeared -- the goal is met and the instrument is not yet useful.' USE THAT WORDING; DO NOT RESTORE THE STRONGER ONE. THIRD, DECIDE THE STRANDED INSTRUMENT. repriced_history.py at specs/results/scorecards/close-the-loop/GOAL-price-means-something/ loads two files CA-02 deleted and dies with FileNotFoundError. The sealed transcripts read; THE CLAIM CANNOT BE RE-DERIVED. CA-08 already decided the general question -- A SEALED TRANSCRIPT DOES NOT SUFFICE, because a transcript proves what a run printed and only a runnable instrument proves the claim can be checked BY SOMEONE WHO DOES NOT TRUST THE TRANSCRIPT. R-H4 FORBIDS REPAIRING A STRANDED SCRIPT, so THE ONLY HONEST MOVES ARE DISCLOSE OR DO-NOT-CUT. Take one, say which, and write the disclosure where a reader of the claim will meet it. FOURTH, RESULT 2 IS DAMAGED BUT STANDING and the damage is priced: derive moves 17 of 21 decided -> 16 of 21, NUMERATOR FELL, DENOMINATOR HELD AT 21. Confirm that at this tree; a replicate was lost, not the result. AND NOTE THE CLASS DISPROOF 1 ESCAPED BY MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN CAUTION: CA-04 was told to delete kill_test.py, measured that run_controls.py:165 imports it at module scope, retained 310 lines -- AND REVIEW THEN FOUND THREE MORE CONSUMERS IT HAD MISSED, because it verified the two it found and stopped looking. DO NOT STOP LOOKING.
